decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line builds directly on the firm's established natural skincare know-how and in-house development, so the firm can read its early results and refine it, and its own dedicated page signals that the firm is committed to it.
A hyaluronic acid serum sits close to the existing facial care range and fits the firm's formulation expertise, so it is easy to absorb, although the website only mentions it briefly.

A cleansing milk is a core natural skincare item that the firm's in-house development and production can readily support and improve, so keeping it is likely even though the website gives it little visibility.
